theorem_title: The actual Chebyshev psi prime-number-theorem rate
formal_statement:
theorem ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.psi_pnt_rate :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => Chebyshev.psi x / x) atTop (nhds 1):= by sorry
natural_language_statement: The actual Chebyshev function satisfies $\psi(x)/x\to1$ as the real variable $x\to+\infty$. This theorem has no hypotheses. It derives the limit from the already proved MediumPNT error estimate for the actual $\psi$, with a positive constant and relative error $\exp(-c(\log x)^{1/10})$ tending to zero.
